description: Service limits, storage policy, the caller's workspace ID (for privacy requests) and a summary of supplier health. Pass supplier_id for one supplier's tools, limits and last health record, or category for a compact list of that category's suppliers.

category.description: Return a compact list of the installed suppliers in this category instead of the summary.

supplier_id.description: Return this installed supplier's full record instead of the summary.
